decisions.reason: As a height-adjustable desk system it is strongly related to our office and conference expertise, and our in-house R&D gives us the absorptive capacity to refine the mechanics and ergonomics despite only modest visible market persistence.
A chair family is very close to our core design, upholstery, materials, and interior-systems knowledge, so we can interpret early results well and improve it within our established portfolio.

Although it builds on our materials competence, floor cushions from carpets are a peripheral niche with weak evidence of sustained traction, so the learning benefits are too limited relative to better uses of resources in our core furniture lines.
The soft upholstered sofa sits squarely in our living and lounge capabilities and its stronger presentation after launch suggests enough promise for us to continue learning and commercial refinement.
The high standing table fits our established workplace and flexible-interior knowledge base, making it a product we can continue to adapt and sell as part of broader office solutions.

The rug collection is the most distant from our established knowledge base, so with limited evidence of lasting success our absorptive capacity to improve and commercialize it is too weak to justify continued commitment.
